expected: Measured peak RAM/VRAM/disk, startup and failures; conservative reproducible fit.
limitations: One authorized GPU compute tenant; the GPU also drives a display (2 graphics clients counted by G10).

The minimum sampled free RAM is only 367714304 bytes; successful completion does not establish comfortable RAM reserve or fit with other workloads.
Peaks are lifetime maxima of the serving processes alive at the end, not earlier generations; polling can miss shorter peaks.
The 39137267712-byte commit limit and measured display state are part of this fit; a future RAM upgrade changes stock setup choices and requires a different profile.
